entries.name: OpenAI Plugins
entries.summary_en: The current official collection of plugin examples for ChatGPT and Codex, including skill-only and MCP-backed packages.
entries.summary_pt_br: Coleção oficial atual de exemplos de plugins para ChatGPT e Codex, incluindo pacotes somente com skills e pacotes apoiados por MCP.

entries.name: Build iOS Apps
entries.summary_en: Build and debug iOS apps with SwiftUI, App Intents, Xcode, Simulator, performance, and memory workflows.
entries.summary_pt_br: Cria e depura aplicativos iOS com SwiftUI, App Intents, Xcode, Simulator e fluxos de desempenho e memória.

entries.name: Build macOS Apps
entries.summary_en: Build, test, instrument, and debug native macOS apps using SwiftUI, AppKit, Xcode, signing, and unified logging.
entries.summary_pt_br: Cria, testa, instrumenta e depura apps nativos para macOS com SwiftUI, AppKit, Xcode, assinatura e logs unificados.

entries.name: Build Web Apps
entries.summary_en: Build frontend-focused web apps with visual assets, browser testing, UI components, payments, and database guidance.
entries.summary_pt_br: Cria aplicativos web com foco no frontend, recursos visuais, testes no navegador, componentes de UI, pagamentos e bancos de dados.

entries.name: OpenAI Developers
entries.summary_en: Build with OpenAI APIs, Agents SDK, and ChatGPT Apps using official documentation and development workflows.
entries.summary_pt_br: Desenvolve com as APIs da OpenAI, Agents SDK e aplicativos do ChatGPT usando documentação e fluxos oficiais.

entries.name: Plugin Eval
entries.summary_en: Evaluate and benchmark Codex skills and plugins with local reports, scoring explanations, and token-use measurements.
entries.summary_pt_br: Avalia e compara skills e plugins do Codex com relatórios locais, explicações de pontuação e medição de tokens.

entries.name: Superpowers
entries.summary_en: A software-development skill framework covering brainstorming, planning, TDD, debugging, collaboration, and code review.
entries.summary_pt_br: Framework de skills para desenvolvimento de software com ideação, planejamento, TDD, depuração, colaboração e revisão de código.

entries.name: Build Web Data Visualization
entries.summary_en: Design, implement, test, and export browser-based charts, maps, dashboards, diagrams, and advanced visual stories.
entries.summary_pt_br: Projeta, implementa, testa e exporta gráficos, mapas, painéis, diagramas e narrativas visuais para navegador.

entries.name: Data Analytics
entries.summary_en: Answer product and business questions with data, validation, diagnostics, charts, dashboards, notebooks, and reports.
entries.summary_pt_br: Responde perguntas de produto e negócio com validação, diagnóstico, gráficos, painéis, notebooks e relatórios.

entries.name: Life Science Research
entries.summary_en: Route and synthesize evidence across genetics, omics, biology, chemistry, clinical research, and public datasets.
entries.summary_pt_br: Direciona e sintetiza evidências de genética, ômicas, biologia, química, pesquisa clínica e bases públicas.

entries.name: Creative Production
entries.summary_en: Turn briefs, products, and source images into campaign concepts, mood boards, ads, social posts, and launch assets.
entries.summary_pt_br: Transforma briefings, produtos e imagens em conceitos de campanha, painéis de referência, anúncios, posts e materiais de lançamento.

entries.name: Figma
entries.summary_en: Implement Figma designs in code, create Code Connect templates, and generate project-specific design-system rules.
entries.summary_pt_br: Implementa designs do Figma em código, cria modelos Code Connect e gera regras de design system específicas do projeto.

entries.name: Product Design
entries.summary_en: Turn early ideas, URLs, screenshots, and briefs into reviewable product directions, UX audits, and interactive prototypes.
entries.summary_pt_br: Transforma ideias, URLs, capturas e briefings em direções de produto, auditorias de UX e protótipos interativos.

entries.name: Remotion
entries.summary_en: Create programmatic videos with React using reusable guidance for animation, audio, captions, charts, 3D, and transitions.
entries.summary_pt_br: Cria vídeos programáticos com React usando orientações para animação, áudio, legendas, gráficos, 3D e transições.

entries.name: Google Drive
entries.summary_en: Use one entry point for Google Drive search, organization, sharing, and Docs, Sheets, and Slides workflows.
entries.summary_pt_br: Usa uma entrada única para pesquisar, organizar e compartilhar no Drive e trabalhar com Docs, Sheets e Slides.

entries.name: Notion
entries.summary_en: Turn specifications, research, meetings, and workspace context into plans, documentation, and durable knowledge.
entries.summary_pt_br: Transforma especificações, pesquisas, reuniões e contexto do workspace em planos, documentação e conhecimento durável.

entries.name: Codex Security
entries.summary_en: Run reusable security scanning, analysis, validation, triage, and investigation workflows across code and diffs.
entries.summary_pt_br: Executa fluxos reutilizáveis de varredura, análise, validação, triagem e investigação de segurança em código e diffs.
